role: The server's chunk cache for one WorldServer: loads a chunk from disk or the generator, runs the populate four-neighbour rule, queues chunks for unload (the ConcurrentHashMap-backed chunksToUnload set), unloads up to 100 per tick with a save, and forwards creature-list and structure queries to the generator.
scope_reason: Which chunks exist, when they populate and when they unload drive worldgen, entity loading and the whole-server replay. Deferred: native never writes save files; Java writes every checkpoint (product decision, not a gap for the GPU or the golden chain); the in-memory region store covers unload and reload (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md).

members.name: chunksToUnload
members.note: A reimplementation of JDK 8 ConcurrentHashMap's bins, resize and tree bins so iterator().next() yields the same key.

members.name: defaultEmptyChunk
members.note: No object: absent-chunk reads return air, light 0 (world.c get paths, servertick.c, randomtick.c).

members.name: currentChunkProvider
members.note: Dispatch by dimension: chunkgen provide_chunk for the overworld, load_dim_chunk for the Nether and the End.

members.name: currentChunkLoader
members.note: the in-memory region store, a checkpoint's region files at first load

members.name: loadChunkOnProvideRequest
members.note: The oracle's agent mode sets it false; the replay mirrors it.

members.name: loadedChunkHashMap
members.note: Open-addressed chunk map plus a 256-slot direct cache; its iteration order is never observed.

members.name: loadedChunks
members.note: world.load_order keeps the load order that saveAllChunks and entity passes read.

members.name: unloadChunksIfNotNearSpawn

members.name: provideChunk

members.note: the 900-tick autosave and the quit save write bytes only (the unload marks the same pass makes are cl_save_marks); n/a: the save's bytes; every save this game makes is written by the oracle (see notes)

members.note: Up to 100 per call in ConcurrentHashMap iterator order; serverreplay.c sr_unload_step runs it at the head of WorldServer.tick.

notes: GPU hazards in the port: cl_unload_step mallocs an order array on every iteration inside the tick (chunkload.c), and the chunk map is a pointer-per-chunk open-addressed table. Status is partial only because disk saving is not ported; the load, populate and unload order is gated by test_chunkload against ChunkLoadProbe recordings. Gates not re-run for this record. The disk half is n/a (lane/idxworld): every save this game makes is the oracle's (a checkpoint's save, session.sh's Save and Quit through Java: AGENTS.md 'Playing a full game'), and the native engine reads what it wrote (region.c for the overworld's region files, the snapshot's saved chunks for DIM-1 and DIM1, structures.json, villages.nbt, worldinfo.nbt, player_server.nbt); writing those files natively is the deferred product work of the 2026-09-25 triage (SPEC.md NEXT, '11 deferred save-writing'; out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md, 'Deferred, not noise'). Within a session nothing reads a save back: an unloaded chunk waits whole in the in-memory region store (sr_store_chunk) with what writeChunkToNBT keeps of it (the entities it saves, in section order; the pending ticks relative to the world time), and a reload restores exactly that (the persist-* and play-reload recordings). lane/villagetrade 2026-09-27: the tail-only evidence (X-01/X-02) now points at the full re-records persist-village-full-s42, whose native replay starts before the behaviour.
